name: Lupine Science
tagline: Unlocking the materials that build the future.
oneLiner: Lupine Science makes AI predictions for new materials trustworthy before a lab spends a year on them.
description: Lupine Science is an early-stage deep-tech company building a verification layer for AI-driven materials discovery. It measures the structured error of machine-learned interatomic potentials (MLIPs), corrects that error at runtime as a physical field beside the model, and seals its quantitative claims as machine-checked Lean 4 theorems over provenance-hashed data, in public.
funding: Independent. No outside capital raised to date.
seeking: Talking with deep-tech investors, materials labs, and MLIP builders ahead of TMS2027.

approach.text: Prediction errors of interatomic potentials are not random. In the committed benchmark they collapse onto a low-dimensional ribbon, and the dominant error directions are largely shared across potentials.
A measured error field runs beside an existing MLIP as an additive energy term with analytic forces. No fine-tuning, no retraining.
Quantitative claims are sealed as Lean 4 theorems over provenance-hashed data. Corrections are licensed only where evidence supports them; unsupported cases abstain.

audiences.text: Start with the founding thesis, the Savings Stack booklet, and the environmental-series proof pack. Every number links to the committed data it was computed from.
Start with the live evidence and the benchmark it is computed from, including the corrections that failed.
Start with the instrument: inspect structures and error fields in the browser.
